Name: Servier
Information:
**Servier**

The rank-and-file members of the Blackwind who have not yet achieved any sort of mastery are given no proper title, and are referred to internally as serviers. They aspire to greatness, but rarely manage to achieve it. They are treated by most higher-ranking members as expendable and devoid of personal freedom.

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.description: The servier has advantage on saving throws made to resist being charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Psychic Bludgeoning (1/Turn)
traits.description: When the servier hits a target with a weapon attack, they can choose to deal an additional d8 of psychic damage.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 40/120 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 2) piercing.
